Bill.BriefDescription: Requesting and implementing a waiver to authorize Washington state to enroll certain individuals in the state health benefit exchange rather than medicaid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requesting and implementing a federal waiver toallow Washington to expand the medicaid program through privateinsurance markets; adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that: (a) On March 23, 2010, President Barack Obama signed into law thepatient protection and affordable care act and the health care andeducation reconciliation act of 2010, collectively known as theaffordable care act; (b) The affordable care act requires that states expand theirmedicaid programs to include coverage for all individuals whose incomesare at or below one hundred thirtythree percent of the federal povertyguidelines; (c) The United States supreme court has found that the medicaidexpansion aspect of the affordable care act shifts medicaid from aprogram for the neediest in society to a comprehensive plan to provideuniversal health insurance coverage; p. 1 SB 5918 (d) The state has made great progress in establishing a Washingtonhealth benefit exchange to serve people over one hundred thirtythreepercent of the federal poverty guidelines as a marketplace forinsurance as required under the affordable care act. (2) Individuals who will be newly eligible for medicaid under theaffordable care act deserve the same choices in their health carecoverage as those being served in the Washington health benefitexchange will have. Making the Washington health benefit exchangeavailable to the thousands of people in Washington who will be forcedto receive health care through the medicaid expansion will giveindividuals a choice in their health care and allow them to maintainthe same health insurance and health care providers if their incomechanges. (3) The legislature intends to require the health care authority towork with the Washington health benefit exchange to develop and requesta waiver from the United States department of health and human servicesto provide health insurance to those individuals who are newly eligiblefor medicaid through the Washington health benefit exchange.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By July 1, 2014, the authority shall apply to the secretary ofthe United States department of health and human services for a waiverto authorize Washington state to enroll individuals at or below amodified adjusted gross income of one hundred thirtythree percent ofthe federal poverty guidelines in the Washington health benefitexchange, rather than medicaid. The waiver must allow Washingtonresidents at or below a modified adjusted gross income of one hundredthirtythree percent of the federal poverty guidelines to receivepremium assistance and costsharing subsidies to allow them to purchasehealth insurance through the Washington health benefit exchange. Thewaiver must combine federal and state sources of funds up to the sameamount and the same proportion that would have been used had theenrollees been covered through medicaid. (2) The authority, in collaboration with the Washington healthbenefit exchange, shall submit a report to the legislature by December SB 5918 p. 2 1, 2013, with details of the operational and fiscal elements of thewaiver proposal.
